stances.summary: Credits border security bill passage, criticizes Democratic obstruction
stances.quote: Democrats’ reckless blockade of border security and law enforcement is finally behind us. If there’s a lesson to take from their months of madness, it’s the importance of regular-order, full-year funding bills. And that’s where I’ll continue to put my full attention.
